verification.precondition: A production run has issued one current SurveyFrame assignment and one skeleton-preserving completed text form exists.
verification.stimulus: Submit the form, discard the command result, reread session.json, and execute validate through a fresh reopen.
verification.expectedSemanticState: One committed SurveyFrame advances the durable workspace to round_1_frame_required and authenticated replay validates without issues.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: surveyctl submit durably commits the SurveyFrame and validate certifies the persisted replay
verification.forbiddenMutation: Submission must not remain warm-only, retain an open assignment, or report validity without replaying persisted state.

behavior: surveyctl submit durably commits the SurveyFrame and validate certifies the persisted replay
